doc.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Recitals and never being stage-frightened
summary: She performed in recitals without stage fright, though she says she does not enjoy being on stage and can simply do it.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And hymns. So, your, umm, recall there’s of course as taking piano lessons there’s always recitals. Was there multiple recitals in your early days?
Ok, and did you find pleasure or a liking to performing at that period of time to audiences?
I wasn’t stage frightened by being... ever. To this day I’m not uncomfortable on stage more than I feel right now.
So you were born to be on stage.
Maybe if I stood up over there.
No, that’ really silly because later on I will tell you that I don’t enjoy it at all.
